It covers everything in one place: ads, social posts, emails, blog posts, and video scripts, all for a flat $39.99/month with no limits. This was built entirely by a 17 year old from scratch, no team.

records.name: Type & Sell
records.tagline: Automate your e-commerce sales without leaving your browser
records.description: Instantly copy your frequently used messages, sales scripts, and email templates.

records.name: HoldOn
records.tagline: Turn app-opening into a mindfulness moment
records.description: You open TikTok or Instagram 50+ times a day — most of the time without even deciding to. HoldOn intercepts the moment you open an addictive app and shows you a short mindfulness pause. Just a few seconds to reconnect with the present moment. Then you choose: open the app consciously, or close it and move on. What makes it different: → Mindful, not punitive → 100% local → One-time purchase → Fully customizable → Usage stats to track your real progress Built for Android. Free to start.

records.name: FaceTranslator
records.tagline: Real-time voice translator for face-to-face conversations
records.description: Real-time voice translator for face-to-face Chinese-English conversations. Tap, speak, and both parties see instant translations in their own language.

records.name: Preskri
records.tagline: L'assurance d'un traitement bien pris
records.description: L'application de rappels de médicaments et de traitements. Scannez et consultez facilement vos notices. Disponible gratuitement sur iOS.

records.name: Calsyncx
records.tagline: Sync Outlook to Google Calendar instantly with no setup
records.description: Calsyncx is a simple tool that automatically syncs Outlook Calendar to Google Calendar in real time. With a one-time setup, you can connect your Google account and link your Outlook calendar without any complex configuration. Once connected, new events, updates, and deletions are synced instantly across both calendars. Unlike traditional calendar integrations, Calsyncx focuses on speed, reliability, and ease of use.

records.name: Founding Member Soft Launch
records.tagline: Helping real estate agents close more deals
records.description: REdelegate handles real estate paperwork, follow-ups, and compliance so agents can focus on selling. Bilingual. 24/7. Built for the hottest markets in South Florida.

records.name: 3D Text Generator
records.tagline: Create stunning 3D text effects online for free
records.description: Free online tool to create professional 3D text effects without design software. Real-time preview, extensive fonts, advanced customization, and high-quality PNG export. Perfect for social media, logos, and marketing materials.

records.name: CompleteAiTraining.com
records.tagline: #1 AI Learning & Certification Platform for Professionals
records.description: Become an AI expert in your job. CompleteAITraining.com offers personalized learning paths for 240+ roles, with video courses, certifications, prompt courses, Custom GPTs, and a massive AI tools database. Complete AI offers: 600+ courses, 600+ certifications, 7000+ tools, all built to help you save time, increase output, and stay ahead.

records.name: MarkLab Editor
records.tagline: A Clean Mac-native Markdown Editor for Developers
records.description: MarkLab is a clean and Mac-native app, no electron. It's distraction free, without subscriptions or ads, and it has a fast live preview so you can see formatting update in real time. I also built it with devblogs in mind, and added frontmatter support so you can edit post metadata with ease.

records.name: Omen Founder App
records.tagline: Turn documents into founder profiles, graphs, and insight.
records.description: Omen Founder App is focused on one practical goal: build a founder as a structured strategic actor for downstream strategic reasoning workflows. What it does today - Generate founder persona - Generate strategy-chain output (formation + why) - Generate insight output (gap-focused) - Visualize founder influence graph and timeline Would love your feedback on: - analysis quality - graph/timeline usability - workflow clarity - what to improve next Thanks for checking it out 🙌

records.name: Random Country Generator
records.tagline: Explore World
records.description: A random country generator that displays a country’s map, flag, and key facts. Discover countries from around the world one at a time with each click.

records.name: Bay Bridge Garage Door
records.tagline: Garage Door Repair, Spring & Opener Installation
records.description: Bay Bridge Garage Door provides expert garage door repair, installation, and maintenance services in San Francisco and surrounding cities. We handle emergency garage door repairs, broken spring replacement, opener and motor installation, and complete garage door fixes for both residential and commercial properties. Our certified technicians are available 24/7 from Sunday to Friday to resolve urgent issues quickly and safely.

records.name: Vivaspoon
records.tagline: What spoon were you born with?
records.description: Vivaspoon assigns you one of 5 spoon archetypes — Bloom, Spark, Terra, Edge, or Flow — based on your birth data and the Korean Five Elements system (오행). It's not fortune-telling. It's a modern lens for self-understanding, rooted in saju (사주), Korea's ancient birth chart tradition. Enter your birth date and time → get your spoon type in seconds.

records.name: CalcStack
records.tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified leads instantly
records.description: CalcStack is an interactive content platform for lead generation. Businesses embed interactive tools on their websites to convert visitors into qualified leads. Unlike static forms that convert 2-3%, interactive content converts 30-50% of visitors. CalcStack includes 250+ pre-built templates, 7 different tool types across 14 industries, industry benchmarks, AI-powered tool generation, conditional insights, lead scoring, and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, and more.

records.name: Digiflex Solutions
records.tagline: Strategy That Converts
records.description: SEO strategy that converts, start seeing results in 3 months only, grantee Google first page rankings in 8 months

records.name: Personal Accountant
records.tagline: AI-powered finance: talk, snap, or just ask
records.description: Most finance apps feel like spreadsheets. Personal Accountant is an AI that manages your money for you. Say "Add 4 for taxi" - it categorizes and confirms. Snap a receipt - it extracts everything. Ask "Is this tax deductible?" - it answers based on your country's rules. The AI remembers you (country, profession, habits) and gets smarter over time. It builds budgets and gives financial advice - zero setup. Web dashboard with spreadsheet + receipt export for businesses. MCP server coming soon.

records.name: MockNova
records.tagline: The 100% Client-Side Data Engine: Generate, Clean & Mock
records.description: MockNova is a privacy-first data engine for developers. Generate up to 100k rows of complex relational data, clean messy logs with "Magic Extract," and mock APIs locally using MSW—all 100% client-side. No backend, no data leaves your machine, and zero paywalls. Perfect for frontend testing, SQL practice, and data science. Features "Chaos Mode" for dirty data testing and a built-in API mocking server. Fast, free, and built for speed. Stop fighting with limits and start building.

records.name: Pieno
records.tagline: he fuel price app Italy deserved but never had
records.description: Find the cheapest fuel prices in real-time across Italy with our intelligent, community-driven station locator.

records.name: Egonix
records.tagline: NFC Card
records.description: Egonix - La plateforme de cartes de visite NFC intelligentes. Partagez vos coordonnées en un tap, créez des profils riches, capturez des contacts avec tracking.

records.name: FinNexus
records.tagline: FinTech, Financial planning, AI Financial
records.description: Manage all your financials portfolio with AI alerting, checking news and more..

records.name: LernChamp
records.tagline: Smart shool companio for Baarian students
records.description: LernChamp is a smart school companion built specifically for Bavarian students at Gymnasium and Realschule. It predicts upcoming exam dates based on the official LehrplanPLUS curriculum, generates study plans around school holidays, and calculates grades using Bavaria's 2:1 weighting. It even has a pop quiz radar that estimates the probability of unannounced tests. 100% offline, no tracking, GDPR compliant. Free with optional one-time premium upgrade.
